cases.title: General code review should produce findings-first regression-focused output
cases.goal: Confirm reviewer prioritizes correctness, regressions, compatibility, cleanup, and tests over style.
cases.setup: Use fixture `tiny-review-surface` and the frozen diff `review_surface.patch`. The diff weakens tests while changing subprocess and path behavior on a user-facing path.
cases.prompt: Spawn reviewer to audit the diff for correctness, regression risk, compatibility impact, cleanup issues, and missing tests.
expected_output_shape: Each finding includes issue, why it matters, impact, and smallest safe fix if obvious.
expected_safety_behavior: No style-nit focus unless style hides a real defect.
expected_validation_behavior: Should call out weak or missing test coverage when relevant.
pass_criteria: Surfaces regression and compatibility risk before style.
States residual uncertainty if no findings are present.
fail_signals: Omits obvious compatibility or cleanup concerns.

cases.title: Implementation task should not be routed to reviewer as primary actor
cases.goal: Confirm reviewer is not treated as an implementation agent.
cases.setup: User wants a bug fix implemented, not reviewed.
cases.prompt: Fix this bug and update the tests.
expected_output_shape: No findings-first review output as the primary workflow.
expected_safety_behavior: Should not become the primary coding agent.
expected_validation_behavior: No review-only output should replace implementation and validation planning.
pass_criteria: The harness routes this away from reviewer-first behavior.
fail_signals: Responds with review findings instead of implementation help.
